title: pyHelioFITS
description: pyHelioFITS is the Python side of the HelioFITS Suite, installed as the pyheliofits package. It holds HelioFITS Core (the hfcore solar-data library: find data, download it and keep it in one indexed library), a client for a running HelioFITS Studio, the library's cache verbs for scripts and notebooks, a reader and replayer for Studio's export records (hfrecord), and an MCP server (heliofits-mcp) that exposes them to an LLM client.
